widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

Generate video and sound, or replace a character or head using the visible timeline footage and a replacement picture.

1. On the **Sonder Editor** node, choose your project or **+ Create New**, then click **Open Editor**.
2. Open **Controls** at the upper left. Choose the job in **Modes → Task**, then choose **Mask On** or **Mask Off** in the separate **Mask** row.
3. Click **notes hidden** below Modes to show the workflow notes. Read **H3 setup**, then **Use References** or **Swap a character or head** for your Task.
4. For either swap Task, start with **Generation Settings → Swap Strength = 1**. Increase it if the swap is failing; lower it if it changes unintended details.

[Watch the showcase video](https://youtu.be/y5QkousNNWo)

## MiniMax H3

Generate video and sound, or replace a character or head using the visible timeline footage and a replacement picture.

1. On the **Sonder Editor** node, choose your project or **+ Create New**, then click **Open Editor**.
2. Open **Controls** at the upper left. Choose the job in **Modes → Task**, then choose **Mask On** or **Mask Off** in the separate **Mask** row.
3. Click **notes hidden** below Modes to show the workflow notes. Read **H3 setup**, then **Use References** or **Swap a character or head** for your Task.
4. For either swap Task, start with **Generation Settings → Swap Strength = 1**. Increase it if the swap is failing; lower it if it changes unintended details.

[Watch the showcase video](https://youtu.be/y5QkousNNWo)

In ComfyUI, choose your project on the **Sonder Editor** node and click **Open Editor**. In Sonder App, pick your project in the Launcher and click **Open**. Open **Controls** at the upper left. If the workflow notes are hidden, click **notes hidden** below **Modes**.

Choose what to do under **Modes → Task**: generate video and sound, generate one while keeping the other, or choose **Character Swap** or **Head Swap**.

Choose **Modes → Mask** separately. **Mask On** restricts video changes to the area you describe. **Mask Off** edits without a spatial restriction. Neither choice changes the Task’s sound settings.

Read **H3 setup** before the first run. For generation with your own media, follow **Use References**. For a replacement, follow **Swap a character or head**, then **Focus an edit with a spatial mask** if needed.","group":"","order":9},"h3_setup":{"text":"**H3 setup**

**Install the required nodes.** In ComfyUI, use **Extensions → ComfyUI Manager** at the top right to install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF). Restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser after installation. This workflow also uses ComfyUI’s built-in H3, SAM3 and LoRA-list nodes.

**Set the scene format.** Above the timeline, choose **Model → MiniMax H3** and **Channels → MiniMax H3 (full reference)**.

**Select your model files.** Read **Models and downloads** below. In **Controls**, click **advanced hidden** if that button appears below Modes, then expand **Models and LoRAs** and select the matching installed files.

**Choose the Task and Mask.** Use the two separate rows at the top of Controls. For a swap, prepare the source footage and replacement picture as described in **Swap a character or head**.

**Set the two strengths separately.** Under **Generation Settings**, **Change Strength (Denoise)** controls how much the source footage is reworked. Start at **1** for new content or a full swap. **Swap Strength** controls the head or character replacement; start at **1** and follow the guidance beside that control.

**Prepare a short first test.** In the toolbar above the timeline, set **In** and **Out** inside the source footage. Start with **Ctx: Pre 0 / Post 0** and **Mask: − 0 / + 0**. Open **Render Queue** below the left sidebar and turn **Queue Active** off to use this selection.

**Generate.** In ComfyUI, click **✕ Exit** at the upper right of the editor, then **Run**. In Sonder App, click **[Generate](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/sonder-app.md#generate)** with **×1** selected.","group":"","order":10},"h3_models":{"text":"**Models and downloads**

Click a filename to open its download page. Put it in the folder shown inside **ComfyUI/models/**.

- **Main model - ref2va (selected in this workflow):** [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) → **diffusion_models/**. More faithful to your References.
- **Alternative main model - fl2va:** [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) → **diffusion_models/**. Better sound and overall quality, at the cost of Reference accuracy.
- **Text encoder:** [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) → **text_encoders/**
- **Video VAE:** [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors) → **vae/H3/**
- **Audio VAE:** [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) → **vae/H3/**
- **Turbo LoRA:** [minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors) → **loras/H3/**
- **Head swaps:** [minimax_h3_head_swap_v1.0_r32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video/blob/main/h3/minimax_h3_head_swap_v1.0_r32.safetensors) → **loras/H3/**
- **Character swaps:** [minimax_h3_character_swap_v1.1_ref2va_fro.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_character_swap_v1.1_ref2va_fro.safetensors) → **loras/H3/**
- **Automatic mask detection:** [sam3.1_multiplex_int8_convrot_selective_fp16clip_fp32source.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Sparknight/sam3.1-int8-int4-convrot/blob/main/sam3.1_multiplex_int8_convrot_selective_fp16clip_fp32source.safetensors) → **checkpoints/**
- **Sampling preview:** [taeh3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/blob/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors) → **vae_approx/**

To switch main models, open **Controls** at the upper left, show advanced settings if hidden, then expand **Models and LoRAs** and choose the file in **Video Model**.

Load the matching swap LoRA for **Character Swap** or **Head Swap**. The SAM3 checkpoint is used with **Modes → Mask → Mask On**. **Mask Off** skips automatic detection. **Additional LoRAs** is optional.

- **Use models from other folders.** If **advanced hidden** appears below Modes, click it. Expand **Models and LoRAs** and select your installed files in the matching model and LoRA controls.","group":"","order":11},"h3_references":{"text":"**Use References**

**[References](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md)** supply a character's appearance, a place, a visual example or a sound. They guide generation without becoming visible Video clips. Use this note for the three generation Tasks; swap Tasks use the picture setup here and the next note.

1. **Register your media.** In **References** at the upper left, click **+**, fill **Name**, then **Save**. Expand the new Reference, click **+ Member**, choose **Image**, **Video** or **Audio**, and select its asset. Fill **Member name** and **Prompt**, then **Save**. Use **Prompt** to describe what that member shows or contains.
2. **Place it in time.** Drag the member from **References** onto the timeline ruler, or click **Add to timeline** on its Reference card to stage the card's members at the playhead. Move or trim its Reference item to cover the section where it should apply. Adding media to the Library alone does not send it to the model.
3. **Choose how H3 receives it.** Click **☰** on the Reference lane header to open **Reference Lane Setup**. Under **Recipe → Template**, choose **MiniMax H3 Pictures**, **MiniMax H3 Videos (IMAGE sequences)** or **MiniMax H3 Standalone Audio** for the media you added. Keep different media types on separate Reference lanes.
4. **Choose the lanes this workflow reads.** Defaults: **R1: pictures · R2: videos · R3: audio**. Only change these selectors if you use different lanes. To change them, in **Controls**, click **advanced hidden** if it appears, expand **Generation References**, then set **Picture Reference Lanes**, **Video Reference Lanes** and **Audio Reference Lanes** to your lanes. The graph accepts up to **9 pictures, 3 videos and 3 standalone audio** inputs.
5. **Use it in the prompt.** For generation Tasks, describe the action in a timeline **Prompt** section. Open **Prompt Management** from **☰** on the Prompt lane, then click **+ Attach → Reference** to attach the source you use. Follow **[H3 Subject or Picture setup](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md#minimax-h3-full-reference)** for a character's identity, its appearance and what should carry over.

After choosing **In / Out**, check that the intended Reference item reads **In window**. See **[Reference timing](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md#what-a-generation-window-resolves-to)** if it is excluded. This graph reads video References as pictures over time; use the standalone Audio Reference input for reference sound.","group":"","order":12},"h3_swaps":{"text":"**Swap a character or head**

1. **Place the source footage on a Video lane.** Keep its soundtrack on an Audio lane if you want that sound in the result. One visible Video clip supplies both the source picture and swap guidance. Check it in the **Composite** preview.
2. **Prepare the replacement picture.** Follow **Use References** to add one image member and stage it on a **MiniMax H3 Pictures** Reference lane over the section you will process. In the Library member’s **Prompt**, describe the replacement’s appearance: body and clothing for a character swap; head, face and hair for a head swap.
3. **Select that picture lane.** In **Controls** at the upper left, show advanced settings if they are hidden. Expand **Swap Sources** and set **Replacement Picture Lane** to the lane you prepared. Keep the intended picture first in its Reference item.
4. **Choose the replacement.** Under **Modes → Task**, choose **Character Swap** or **Head Swap**. Both keep timeline audio. Choose **Mask On** or **Mask Off** in the separate **Mask** row.
5. **Set Swap Strength.** Expand **Generation Settings** and start at **1**. Increase it if the swap is failing. Lower it if the swap changes unintended details. This control applies to both swap Tasks.

These Tasks build their swap prompt from the replacement picture member’s **Prompt**; they do not use the timeline Prompt. Select a short **In / Out** range for the first run, then follow **H3 setup → Generate**.","group":"","order":13},"h3_masked_swaps":{"text":"**Focus an edit with a spatial mask**

Prepare the source footage on a **Video** lane. For a character or head replacement, follow **Swap a character or head** first. The visible timeline picture supplies the mask source and swap guidance.

1. In **Controls → Modes → Task**, choose the work you want to do. Then choose **Mask On** in the separate **Mask** row.
2. In **Who do you want to mask?**, below Modes in Controls, describe the area that may change. For example: the woman on the left, or the head of the woman on the left. For a **Head Swap**, describe the head if you want the mask limited to it.
3. At the top of a viewport pane, open its source menu and choose **Spatial Mask Preview**. Click that pane’s **Run** button to inspect the mask for your current selection.
4. Expand **Mask Settings** in Controls. **Grow / Shrink Mask** changes the region’s size; **Mask Edge Softness** softens its border. Run the preview again after an adjustment. White permits video changes, black protects, and grey softens the amount of change.
5. Follow **H3 setup → Generate** to run the selected section.

**Mask Off** skips detection and removes the spatial restriction while keeping the same Task and temporal selection. Masking affects video; the chosen Task still decides whether audio is generated or kept.","group":"","order":14},"h3_review":{"text":"**Review and continue**

**Find the result.** Open **Assets** at the upper left, then **Takes**. With **Controls → Editor → Save as → Take**, the result is also placed on the timeline. **Video** saves it in Assets without placing it.

**Choose which picture plays.** If **Controls → Editor → Takes start muted** is on, a new take will not change the Composite until you unmute it. Right-click the take’s Video clip and choose **Unmute Selected**. Use **Mute Selected** on competing takes, or hide their Video lanes with the eye at the left. Check the result with **Play** below the preview.

**Choose the source for the next attempt.** The visible timeline picture feeds the next swap and mask detection. Keep the original visible when comparing independent attempts; show a chosen take when you want to edit that result further.

**Keep one copy of the sound.** Both swap Tasks keep the audio already on the timeline. Their saved videos include that audio, while **Place take audio on timeline** stays off to avoid adding it again.

**Choose an output format before generating.** Under **Controls → Editor → Output Format**, use **High Quality MP4** for everyday review and sharing. For another editing pass, choose **Editing Master MP4** or **Lossless FFV1 (RGB)**. Lossless files can be much larger.

To compare saved versions, use [Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode). To refine or enlarge a chosen result, open [LTX 2.5 Refine & Upscale](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/example_workflows/sonder_ltx_2_5_refine_upscale.json).","group":"","order":15}},"groups":{"Generation Settings":{"order":1},"Mask Settings":{"order":2},"Models and LoRAs":{"order":3},"Generation References":{"order":4},"Swap Sources":{"order":5},"Processing Switches":{"order":6}},"description":"## MiniMax H3

**Install the required nodes.** In ComfyUI, use **Extensions → ComfyUI Manager** at the top right to install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF). Restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser after installation. This workflow also uses ComfyUI’s built-in H3, SAM3 and LoRA-list nodes.

**Set the scene format.** Above the timeline, choose **Model → MiniMax H3** and **Channels → MiniMax H3 (full reference)**.

**Select your model files.** Read **Models and downloads** below. In **Controls**, click **advanced hidden** if that button appears below Modes, then expand **Models and LoRAs** and select the matching installed files.

**Choose the Task and Mask.** Use the two separate rows at the top of Controls. For a swap, prepare the source footage and replacement picture as described in **Swap a character or head**.

**Set the two strengths separately.** Under **Generation Settings**, **Change Strength (Denoise)** controls how much the source footage is reworked. Start at **1** for new content or a full swap. **Swap Strength** controls the head or character replacement; start at **1** and follow the guidance beside that control.

**Prepare a short first test.** In the toolbar above the timeline, set **In** and **Out** inside the source footage. Start with **Ctx: Pre 0 / Post 0** and **Mask: − 0 / + 0**. Open **Render Queue** below the left sidebar and turn **Queue Active** off to use this selection.

**Generate.** In ComfyUI, click **✕ Exit** at the upper right of the editor, then **Run**. In Sonder App, click **[Generate](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/sonder-app.md#generate)** with **×1** selected.","group":"","order":10},"h3_models":{"text":"**Models and downloads**

**[References](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md)** supply a character's appearance, a place, a visual example or a sound. They guide generation without becoming visible Video clips. Use this note for the three generation Tasks; swap Tasks use the picture setup here and the next note.

1. **Register your media.** In **References** at the upper left, click **+**, fill **Name**, then **Save**. Expand the new Reference, click **+ Member**, choose **Image**, **Video** or **Audio**, and select its asset. Fill **Member name** and **Prompt**, then **Save**. Use **Prompt** to describe what that member shows or contains.
2. **Place it in time.** Drag the member from **References** onto the timeline ruler, or click **Add to timeline** on its Reference card to stage the card's members at the playhead. Move or trim its Reference item to cover the section where it should apply. Adding media to the Library alone does not send it to the model.
3. **Choose how H3 receives it.** Click **☰** on the Reference lane header to open **Reference Lane Setup**. Under **Recipe → Template**, choose **MiniMax H3 Pictures**, **MiniMax H3 Videos (IMAGE sequences)** or **MiniMax H3 Standalone Audio** for the media you added. Keep different media types on separate Reference lanes.
4. **Choose the lanes this workflow reads.** Defaults: **R1: pictures · R2: videos · R3: audio**. Only change these selectors if you use different lanes. To change them, in **Controls**, click **advanced hidden** if it appears, expand **Generation References**, then set **Picture Reference Lanes**, **Video Reference Lanes** and **Audio Reference Lanes** to your lanes. The graph accepts up to **9 pictures, 3 videos and 3 standalone audio** inputs.
5. **Use it in the prompt.** For generation Tasks, describe the action in a timeline **Prompt** section. Open **Prompt Management** from **☰** on the Prompt lane, then click **+ Attach → Reference** to attach the source you use. Follow **[H3 Subject or Picture setup](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md#minimax-h3-full-reference)** for a character's identity, its appearance and what should carry over.

After choosing **In / Out**, check that the intended Reference item reads **In window**. See **[Reference timing](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md#what-a-generation-window-resolves-to)** if it is excluded. This graph reads video References as pictures over time; use the standalone Audio Reference input for reference sound.","group":"","order":12},"h3_swaps":{"text":"**Swap a character or head**

1. **Place the source footage on a Video lane.** Keep its soundtrack on an Audio lane if you want that sound in the result. One visible Video clip supplies both the source picture and swap guidance. Check it in the **Composite** preview.
2. **Prepare the replacement picture.** Follow **Use References** to add one image member and stage it on a **MiniMax H3 Pictures** Reference lane over the section you will process. In the Library member’s **Prompt**, describe the replacement’s appearance: body and clothing for a character swap; head, face and hair for a head swap.
3. **Select that picture lane.** In **Controls** at the upper left, show advanced settings if they are hidden. Expand **Swap Sources** and set **Replacement Picture Lane** to the lane you prepared. Keep the intended picture first in its Reference item.
4. **Choose the replacement.** Under **Modes → Task**, choose **Character Swap** or **Head Swap**. Both keep timeline audio. Choose **Mask On** or **Mask Off** in the separate **Mask** row.
5. **Set Swap Strength.** Expand **Generation Settings** and start at **1**. Increase it if the swap is failing. Lower it if the swap changes unintended details. This control applies to both swap Tasks.

These Tasks build their swap prompt from the replacement picture member’s **Prompt**; they do not use the timeline Prompt. Select a short **In / Out** range for the first run, then follow **H3 setup → Generate**.","group":"","order":13},"h3_masked_swaps":{"text":"**Focus an edit with a spatial mask**

Prepare the source footage on a **Video** lane. For a character or head replacement, follow **Swap a character or head** first. The visible timeline picture supplies the mask source and swap guidance.

1. In **Controls → Modes → Task**, choose the work you want to do. Then choose **Mask On** in the separate **Mask** row.
2. In **Who do you want to mask?**, below Modes in Controls, describe the area that may change. For example: the woman on the left, or the head of the woman on the left. For a **Head Swap**, describe the head if you want the mask limited to it.
3. At the top of a viewport pane, open its source menu and choose **Spatial Mask Preview**. Click that pane’s **Run** button to inspect the mask for your current selection.
4. Expand **Mask Settings** in Controls. **Grow / Shrink Mask** changes the region’s size; **Mask Edge Softness** softens its border. Run the preview again after an adjustment. White permits video changes, black protects, and grey softens the amount of change.
5. Follow **H3 setup → Generate** to run the selected section.

**Mask Off** skips detection and removes the spatial restriction while keeping the same Task and temporal selection. Masking affects video; the chosen Task still decides whether audio is generated or kept.","group":"","order":14},"h3_review":{"text":"**Review and continue**

**Find the result.** Open **Assets** at the upper left, then **Takes**. With **Controls → Editor → Save as → Take**, the result is also placed on the timeline. **Video** saves it in Assets without placing it.

**Choose which picture plays.** If **Controls → Editor → Takes start muted** is on, a new take will not change the Composite until you unmute it. Right-click the take’s Video clip and choose **Unmute Selected**. Use **Mute Selected** on competing takes, or hide their Video lanes with the eye at the left. Check the result with **Play** below the preview.

**Choose the source for the next attempt.** The visible timeline picture feeds the next swap and mask detection. Keep the original visible when comparing independent attempts; show a chosen take when you want to edit that result further.

**Keep one copy of the sound.** Both swap Tasks keep the audio already on the timeline. Their saved videos include that audio, while **Place take audio on timeline** stays off to avoid adding it again.

**Choose an output format before generating.** Under **Controls → Editor → Output Format**, use **High Quality MP4** for everyday review and sharing. For another editing pass, choose **Editing Master MP4** or **Lossless FFV1 (RGB)**. Lossless files can be much larger.

To compare saved versions, use [Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode). To refine or enlarge a chosen result, open [LTX 2.5 Refine & Upscale](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/example_workflows/sonder_ltx_2_5_refine_upscale.json).","group":"","order":15}},"groups":{"Generation Settings":{"order":1},"Mask Settings":{"order":2},"Models and LoRAs":{"order":3},"Generation References":{"order":4},"Swap Sources":{"order":5},"Processing Switches":{"order":6}},"description":"## MiniMax H3

<Subject 2> is the original person in <Video 1>, whose body, neck, clothing, pose, physical proportions below the head, actions, motion, timing, and interaction with the environment must remain unchanged.

<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit, providing the original body performance, motion, camera movement, framing, timing, lighting, environment, scene composition, and temporal structure.

summary:

[video editing + reference generation]

The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace only the entire head of <Subject 2> with the reference head identity defined by <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. Preserve the source video's body, clothing, performance, motion, camera behavior, environment, lighting, timing, and composition.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1> (appears throughout the target video): attribute_transfer - the complete head identity from <Picture 1>, including facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, head shape, proportions, skin appearance, and distinctive features, is transferred consistently onto the body of <Subject 2>.

<Subject 2> (appears throughout the target video): partially_preserved - the original body, neck position, clothing, pose, motion, gestures, actions, and physical performance are preserved, while only the original head is replaced.

<Video 1> (entire target timeline): partially_preserved - the original video timing, body motion, camera movement, framing, lighting, background, environment, scene composition, and temporal structure are preserved; only the subject's head appearance is modified.

detailed_description:

Preserve <Video 1> as the complete temporal and compositional foundation of the target video. <Subject 2> retains the exact original body, clothing, pose, body proportions, movement, gestures, actions, speed, timing, and interaction with the environment.
